channel.title: Nimbus Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Nimbus Google Drive Client

item.title: Nimbus 1.0.0
item.description:
Nimbus 1.0.0 Release Notes

  • macOS 26+ FSKit Support: Full user-space physical filesystem via macFUSE 5.5.0.
  • Multi-Account Disks: Mount multiple Google Drive accounts concurrently into Finder.
  • Background Menu Bar: Keeps mounted drives alive 24/7 when windows are closed.
  • Zero-Disk Engine: On-demand streaming with intelligent L1 RAM and SSD caching.
  • Sparkle Updates: Automatic in-app update checks and seamless releases.
